leads.name: The Tyrant (register)
leads.reason: Off Larkin Rd in forest south of Pemberton, measured 2014, about 220 m3 trunk volume, 'largest karri by volume' (also on Wikipedia 'Eucalyptus diversicolor' as 69 m / 11.5 m girth, ~220 m3). No visitor track or access evidence, no photo: lead.

leads.name: Hawke (register)
leads.reason: Hawke Block off Larkin Rd, measured 2014, about 206 m3; register comments say the track is overgrown. Register copy only, no visitor access evidence, no photo: lead. Register lists girth 13 m, brief said 14.6.
